name: Item code Autofill
script:
# Automatic Item Code based on Item Group
# Server Script
# DocType Event: Item
# Event: Before Insert

series_map = {
    "Finished Goods": "10",
    "Semi Finished Goods": "20",

    "Chemicals": "31",
    "Solvents": "32",
    "Mother Liquor": "33",
    "Cylinders": "34",
    "Excipients": "35",
    "API": "36",

    "Cotton Box": "41",
    "Drums": "42",
    "Polythine Bags": "43",
    "Others": "44",
    "PPM-Primary Packaging Material": "45",
    "SPM-Secondary Packaging Material": "46",
    "TPM-Tertiary Packaging Material": "47",

    "Electricals": "51",
    "Instruments": "52",
    "Utility Spare": "53",
    "Pipes & Fittings": "54",
    "Tools": "55",
    "Machine Spare": "56",
    "Scrap": "57",

    "Printing & Stationary": "61",
    "Production Consumable": "62",
    "Lab Consumable": "63",
    "General Consumable": "64",
    "Oil & Lubricants": "65",
    "IT Consumables": "68",

    "Building & Material": "71",
    "Plant & Machinary": "72",
    "Furniture & Fixture": "73",
    "General Maintenance": "74",

    "Fuels": "81",

    "AMC": "91",
    "CMC": "92",
    "Repairing": "93",
    "FREIGHT": "94"
}


# Starting number for each series
start_map = {
    "10": 1000000,
    "20": 2000000,

    "31": 3100001,
    "32": 3200001,
    "33": 3300001,
    "34": 3400001,
    "35": 3500000,
    "36": 3600001,

    "41": 4100001,
    "42": 4200001,
    "43": 4300001,
    "44": 4400001,
    "45": 4500001,
    "46": 4600001,
    "47": 4700001,

    "51": 5100001,
    "52": 5200001,
    "53": 5300001,
    "54": 5400001,
    "55": 5500001,
    "56": 5600001,
    "57": 5700001,

    "61": 6100001,
    "62": 6200001,
    "63": 6300001,
    "64": 6400001,
    "65": 6500001,
    "68": 6800000,

    "71": 7100001,
    "72": 7200001,
    "73": 7300001,
    "74": 7400000,

    "81": 8100001,

    "91": 9100001,
    "92": 9200001,
    "93": 9300001,
    "94": 9400000
}


item_group = doc.item_group

# Stop if Item Group is not configured
if item_group not in series_map:
    frappe.throw(
        "No Item Code series configured for Item Group: " + str(item_group)
    )

prefix = series_map[item_group]
start_number = start_map[prefix]


# Find all existing item codes belonging to this series
items = frappe.get_all(
    "Item",
    filters={
        "item_code": ["like", prefix + "%"]
    },
    fields=["item_code"],
    order_by="item_code desc",
    limit_page_length=1
)


# If no item exists for this series
if not items:
    next_number = start_number

else:
    latest_code = items[0].item_code

    # Make sure the code is numeric
    try:
        latest_number = int(latest_code)
    except:
        latest_number = start_number - 1

    next_number = latest_number + 1

    # Never go below configured starting number
    if next_number < start_number:
        next_number = start_number


# Assign generated Item Code
doc.item_code = str(next_number)
